document.title: Harmony XB4 metal control and signaling units catalog

modelingNotes: Manufacturer reference ZB4BJ5 corresponds to source spelling ZB4-BJ5 by identical code characters and operating configuration; source punctuation is retained.

Exact catalog row specifies heads only: black long handle, three positions +/-45 degrees, spring return to center. Contact/light blocks and body/contact assemblies are not included in this head abstraction.
2017 ZB4BJ5 product sheet pp.1-3 identifies 22 mm mounting and chromium-plated metal bezel; p.16 describes operation of separately fitted body contacts, not head terminals.
Zero documented electrical terminals or fixed links. Bonding through the head, collar or panel remains undocumented; no mounting-hardware continuity is asserted.
Accessory documentation view only; mechanical behavior is descriptive. No electrical circuit functions or electrical ratings are assigned.

connectionCoverage.notes: Mechanical head with no documented electrical terminals and no included contact/light blocks. Reviewed drawings do not establish an exhaustive PE/bonding inventory or conductive attachment path through the metal head, collar and panel.
